turns.user: Tìm giúp tôi 3 bài báo mới nhất về agentic AI tool calling
turns.assistant_text:
Dưới đây là 3 bài báo và bài viết kỹ thuật liên quan đến việc gọi công cụ (tool calling) trong các hệ thống Agentic AI:

1. **STMicroelectronics công cụ hóa cho Agentic AI**: Giới thiệu khung làm việc STM32Cube cho phép các agent AI tự động gọi các công cụ sinh mã và kiểm tra lỗi tương tác phần cứng.
2. **Đánh giá các framework Agentic AI mã nguồn mở (AIMultiple)**: Phân tích cơ chế tool calling của các framework như smolagents (gọi qua mã Python) và Agno (gọi qua JSON).
3. **Tích hợp tầng ngữ nghĩa với Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (AWS Blog)**: Hướng dẫn quản lý và xác thực quyền gọi công cụ của AI agent dựa trên giao thức MCP và EDB Postgres AI.

Nguồn:
- desmoinesregister.com, ngày không rõ, https://www.desmoinesregister.com/press-release/story/147860/stmicroelectronics-sharpens-agentic-ai-coding-with-new-stm32-tools
- aimultiple.com, ngày không rõ, https://aimultiple.com/agentic-frameworks
- aws.amazon.com, ngày không rõ, https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/build-a-semantic-layer-for-agentic-ai-with-edb-postgres-ai-and-amazon-bedrock-agentcore

Giả định và khoảng trống:
- Ngày xuất bản cụ thể của các bài báo/bài viết không được hiển thị chi tiết trong dữ liệu trích xuất.

items.title: STMicroelectronics sharpens agentic-AI coding with new STM32 tools - The Des Moines Register
items.summary: After code is generated, the new STM32Cube for Agentic AI framework provides a first review to verify API calls, check for correct interactions with MCU hardware, and suggest workarounds. Users can also take advantage of STM32Sidekick, a recently introduced tool that adds 24/7 digital assistant functionality for our customers to answer basic support questions as a first line support with links to relevant data and content. [...] The STM32Cube for Agentic AI framework brings higher efficiency to diverse aspects of AI-based development. It provides high-quality STM32-specific information directly from the manufacturer to help AI agents ensure accuracy, avoid hazards such as hallucinations, and minimize token costs. There is also help for AI agents to select appropriate STM32 ecosystem assets, such as whether to use a ready-made code example or call a code-generation tool. [...] STM32Cube for Agentic AI enables the AI agents to seamlessly use optimized and verified reference code examples created by ST and to use STM32CubeMX, the deterministic code generation tool. This ensures higher code accuracy and determinism, as well as allowing developers to take back control of code development and debug when needed, letting them continue working in their familiar project and coding environment.

items.title: Top 13 Open-Source Agentic AI Frameworks
items.summary:
### smolagents

Its best-known approach is CodeAgent, which calls tools by writing Python code instead of JSON and runs that code locally or in isolated environments such as E2B, Docker or Modal. Tools and agents can be shared on the Hugging Face Hub. We tested ToolCallingAgent, which makes JSON tool calls, so CodeAgent is not part of these results. [...] ### Agno

It ships with a large catalog of ready-made toolkits and offers AgentOS, a runtime for serving and managing agents as an API on your own infrastructure.

In Agno, the model almost never wrote commentary next to its tool calls: it did so in 0.2% of tool-calling turns, against 3% to 26% in the other frameworks. This commentary is billed as output tokens.

### Pydantic AI

items.title: Build a semantic layer for agentic AI with EDB Postgres AI and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Artificial Intelligence
items.summary: Outbound to the semantic layer: The agent’s tool call is an MCP request. AgentCore Gateway supports MCP server targets directly. AIDB’s `edb-endpoints` HTTP server speaks streamable HTTP MCP with HTTP Basic authentication, which lets Gateway treat it as an MCP server target with no translation layer. An Application Load Balancer with an HTTPS listener and an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate fronts `edb-endpoints` on an Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) instance. The ALB URL is [...] Observability: AgentCore emits traces for tool calls, large language model (LLM) calls, and token usage to CloudWatch Transaction Search. AIDB captures OpenTelemetry traces for SQL execution as rows in the `aidb_otel` schema inside Postgres, queryable with ordinary SQL after the database is configured to write them (see enabling telemetry on the source database). [...] Inbound trust at Gateway: 1. The end user authenticates with Amazon Cognito and receives a JWT bearer token. 2. The client calls AgentCore Gateway with the token in the `Authorization` header. 3. The Gateway JWT authorizer validates the token against the Cognito user pool’s discovery URL. 4. Gateway evaluates its Cedar policy against the token’s claims to decide which tool this agent can call.
